sql: with p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, end_date from incentive_programs where incentive_type='liquidity' and (market_ticker like 'KXTRUMPMENTIONB-26OCT19-%' or market_ticker like 'KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT19-%' or market_ticker like 'KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT17-%') order by market_ticker, last_seen_at desc), ev as (select 'KXTRUMPMENTIONB-26OCT19' e, timestamptz '2026-10-19 17:00Z' t union all select 'KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT19', timestamptz '2026-10-20 00:00Z' union all select 'KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT17', timestamptz '2026-10-17 21:00Z'), s as (select s.market_ticker, ev.e, extract(epoch from ev.t - s.at)/3600 h, s.est_yes_score_total ys, s.est_no_score_total ns, s.est_yes_meets_target and s.est_no_meets_target q from incentive_market_snapshots s join ev on s.market_ticker like ev.e||'-%' where s.at > '2026-10-14') select e, split_part(market_ticker,'-',3) w, case when h>=48 then 'early' when h>=0 then 'last48' else 'after' end b, count(*) n, round(min(h)::numeric,0) hmin, round(max(h)::numeric,0) hmax, round(avg(ys)::numeric,0) yscore, round(avg(ns)::numeric,0) nscore, round(avg(q::int)::numeric,2) qual from s group by 1,2,3 order by 1,2,3
